item.title: FIH Women's Junior World Cup: India beat Uruguay in shootout; to play for 9th spot
item.description: Goalkeeper Nidhi saved thrice in the penalty shootout to help India beat Urguay.

item.description: A tough start on debut for the young Indian pair, losing 7-11, 6-11, 8-11 to Wang Chuqin and Sun Yingsha of China.

item.title: Shooting League of India to kick off on February 16
item.description: The league will feature mixed team events in multiple categories including Pistol (10m, 25m), Rifle (10m, 50m 3P), and Shotgun (Trap and Skeet).

item.description: Highlights from the 2025 FIH Men's Junior World Cup clash between India and Argentina.

item.title: India and Italy sign MoU to deepen cooperation in training, sports science
item.description: The agreement enables mutual access to elite training centres and expands athlete and coaching exchanges.

item.title: FIH Men's Junior World Cup: Anmol Ekka leads India to bronze win over Argentina
item.description: Hockey India announced a cash reward of Rs 5 lakh for the players and Rs 2.5 lakh for support staff.

item.title: National Boxing C'ships postponed by four days amid pollution spike
item.description: The 9th Elite National Boxing Championship will now begin on January 4 after pollution-related restrictions forced a change in dates.

item.title: India's big pickleball leap has arrived through the IPBL
